description: Attach a file to a job - a photo, a PDF, a report. The content is passed as base64 because a desktop assistant has no filesystem of its own. The upload is confirmed by listing the job's attachments afterwards.

content_base64.description: The file's bytes, base64-encoded. No data: URI prefix

content_type.description: MIME type, e.g. image/jpeg or application/pdf. Defaults to application/octet-stream

filename.description: The filename to store it under, e.g. nameplate.jpg. Housecall Pro may transcode and rename it

name: hcp_upload_job_attachment
